Keywords: industrial emissions, power plant emissions, factory emissions, industrial effluents, coal-fired power plants, manufacturing, industrial waste, fossil fuel combustion, sewage discharge, untreated effluents

Biomass Burning and Agriculture

Air pollution caused by burning of biomass, especially crop residue (stubble burning), agricultural fires, and related rural burning activities, often in neighboring states but impacting Delhi.

Keywords: crop residue burning, stubble burning, farm fires, agricultural burning, biomass burning, paddy straw burning, bio-decomposer, agricultural residue, slash-and-burn, post-monsoon burning
Examples: Agriculture crop residue burning as well as construction and demolition waste continues to be major concerns; Farm fires are a major reason behind a spike in air pollution in Delhi-NCR in October-November; The dense haze, caused by a mix of local pollution and the seasonal crop burning in neighbouring states, choked the city's skies

Household Fuel and Cooking Emissions

Air pollution from household use of fossil fuels or biomass for cooking and heating, including references to firewood, coal, and domestic burning in homes or small eateries.

Keywords: household emissions, cooking emissions, firewood, coal, biomass for cooking, domestic burning, open eateries, household fuel, kitchen smoke
Examples: The use of coal and firewood in hotels, restaurants and open eateries, and diesel generators, except for essential services among others are banned under stage two of the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP); household use of fossil fuels for cooking; biomass for cooking

Keywords: waste burning, open burning of waste, landfill fires, trash burning, municipal solid waste burning, garbage burning, combustion of waste
Examples: open burning of waste; landfill fires; burning of municipal solid waste

Construction and Road Dust

Air pollution caused by construction activities, demolition, roadworks, and resuspended dust from roads or soil, including references to construction and demolition (C&D) waste.

Keywords: construction dust, road dust, construction and demolition waste, C&D waste, demolition dust, resuspended dust, construction activities, roadworks, particulate matter from construction
Examples: Agriculture crop residue burning as well as construction and demolition waste continues to be major concerns; Unscientific disposal of C&D waste is one of the key contributors to the air and water pollution; As per a study conducted by IIT Kanpur in 2015, C&D is a key contributor towards particulate matter emissions in Delhi
